The button opens the page with the newest version in your web browser. Markdown never checks for updates on its own.

Markdown opens Markdown files and shows them as a neat page. You can also edit a file and save it, or write a new one. Markdown is a way of writing formatted text with plain characters: for example, a # at the start of a line makes a heading.

Markdown collects no personal data. It has no account, no tracking of how you use the app, no advertising and no crash reports. It asks Android for no permissions and cannot connect to the internet. It opens a file only when you choose it or send it to the app, and it saves a file only when you tap Save.
